tasks.enabler_now: Native feature proposals can assist supported tracing with complete human review.
tasks.still_hard: Occlusion, control precision and feature semantics require photogrammetric judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native image-feature proposals can assist some aerial delineation; precision control and final feature interpretation require human verification.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual imagery/control producers supply source geometry, calibration/reference and accuracy metadata; cartographer verifies in s1. No automatic control-point truth or invisible features inferred.

Native fixed drafting first; existing assistance earns zero saving. Proposals only validated feature classes; unsupported control/hydrographic/terrain detail remains manual. Actual manual instrument route without compatible imagery gets zero s2 saving and reweight.
Final save retained; any actual register update/publication is separately final-version gated. Compilation shared with3517 counted once.
